AfterAddedToRoom.rationale: SHARED-FINDINGS section 2, copied verbatim as that section binds every batch. The sim has no add-to-room phase - creature creation IS construction - so AfterAddedToRoom's effect is applied from __init__ (sewer_clam.py:26-30). Same observable today, established by execution rather than assumed, on all three clauses: (a) listener set - the only ported listeners on the hooks a starting power can reach are relics/ruined_helmet.py:23-38 and relics/unsettling_lamp.py:44-53 (modify_power_amount) and relics/vambrace.py:26-40 / relics/paels_legion.py:36-43 (modify_block_multiplicative); all four gate on target is self.player / applier is self.player / card is not None, and a monster's starting power is self-applied with no card, so none of them can fire; sts2_rl/potions.py implements none of the four hooks. (b) HP-roll inversion - the sim applies the power before the Niche roll and the game after it; of the 35 constructor-applied power classes only IllusionPower mentions max_hp at all and only inside revive() (powers.py:1581), never at apply time. (c) roll ordering - MachineMonster.__init__ rolls the first move (state_machine.py:301) before the subclass applies its powers, but `py audit/tools/monster_probes.py roll-order` shows all 29 machine sites are sticky-no-op: every initial state is a MoveState, so monster_state_machine step 30's early return fires and the first roll evaluates no branch and reads no power. Concrete trigger that would make it a gap: any relic, potion or power listening on modify_power_amount / on_power_applied / modify_block_* without gating on the player, or a starting power whose amount reads owner.max_hp. RULE 7 NOTE: that rationale cites four relic files and powers.py which this record does NOT hash, exactly as the seam records disclose. Payload matches: SewerClam.cs:29-34 computes GetValueIfAscension(ToughEnemies, 9, 8) = 8 non-ascension and applies PlatingPower at that amount to itself; sewer_clam.py:30 applies PlatingPower 8. Clause (c) holds - the initial state is the MoveState JET_MOVE (executed: monster_probes_b03.py graphs, initial=JET_MOVE, log=['JET_MOVE']) - and no amount reads max_hp. WORTH SAYING for this unit because the power is Plating and Plating grants BLOCK: the block is not gained in __init__ but from PlatingPower.on_combat_start (powers.py:1054-1056), which runs at hooks.on_combat_start (combat.py:208), i.e. AFTER relics attach (combat.py:157-159) - so the block-modifier listeners section 2's clause (a) enumerates get their normal turn at their normal time and the inversion does not reach them.
